 Follow SSI payments won't go out as normal for November. Why the change
 Iris Seaton, Asheville Citizen Times Updated Mon, October 26, 2026 at 4:13 PM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. SSI payments won't go out as normal for November. Why the change Millions of Social Security recipients are due for another payment this week, with Supplemental Security Income recipients also scheduled to receive November's payment early.
 The final round of October benefits is scheduled for Wednesday, Oct. 28 , with the payment going to beneficiaries on the regular schedule whose birthdays fall between the 21st and 31st of any month.
 Two days later, on Friday, Oct. 30, Supplemental Security Income recipients are scheduled to receive their November payment early because Nov. 1 falls on a Sunday.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Here's what to know about the upcoming Social Security and SSI payment dates in North Carolina.
 When are Social Security payments sent?
 For beneficiaries on the regular payment schedule, Social Security payments are distributed according to birth date:
 Born on the 1st through 10th: Second Wednesday of the month
 Born on the 11th through 20th: Third Wednesday of the month
 Born on the 21st through 31st: Fourth Wednesday of the month
 The schedule means beneficiaries with birthdays from the 21st through 31st are due to receive their October payment on Wednesday, Oct. 28, the final regular Wednesday payment date of the month. The Social Security Administration's 2026 payment calendar confirms that benefits for this group are paid on the fourth Wednesday.
 Advertisement Advertisement People who began receiving Social Security before May 1997 follow a different schedule. Those receiving both Social Security and SSI generally receive Social Security on the third day of the month and SSI on the first, according to the administration's calendar.
 If a payment doesn't arrive on the expected date, the Social Security Administration advises waiting three additional mailing days before contacting the agency.
 When is the next SSI payment?
 Supplemental Security Income is generally paid on the first of the month. November's payment, however, is scheduled to arrive Friday, Oct. 30, because Nov. 1 falls on a Sunday.
 The remaining SSI payment dates on the SSA's 2026 calendar are:
 Advertisement Advertisement Friday, Oct. 30: November 2026 payment
 Tuesday, Dec. 1: December 2026 payment
 Thursday, Dec. 31: January 2027 payment
 Full 2026 Social Security payment calendar
 How many people in North Carolina receive Social Security benefits?
 The  SSA website  lists 217,030 N.C. residents receiving  SSI  benefits as of May 2025. The most recent data available for the state is for December 2024, when the agency identified 2,329,477 beneficiaries.
 How many people in the U.S. receive Social Security benefits?
 Across the nation, 74,090,000 people were receiving Social Security benefits as of May 2025. This includes 57,164,000 eligible due to their age and 16,927,000 eligible due to blindness, another disability or other reasons.
 Fernando Cervantes Jr., USA TODAY, contributed to this report.
